From the owner
Same house. The dormers, the roofline and the chimney have not moved. What changed is everything at eye level: dark vertical siding where the white clapboard was on the ground floor, a new glass-panel front door under an orange entry surround, and a side yard that is now a private courtyard with a pergola, wide steps and planters. Most of the character of a house lives in the first eight feet.
